lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the circular blobs, primarily visible in the mid-flank area where blobs are positioned as nodes within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient showing higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, thin white linear mark is visible on the dorsal surface near the midline, oriented longitudinally.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-colored teleost fish (remoras) clustered near the ventral margin of the pectoral fin and gill area.
